applications.name: general
applications.requirements: Resolve an explicit application and objective; no hidden application defaults.

applications.name: oncology
applications.requirements: Paralog and both-strand specificity; distinguish target knockdown from seed-driven viability.

applications.name: genetic-disease-total-lowering
applications.requirements: Clarify intended total lowering and wild-type function; do not imply allele selectivity.

applications.name: genetic-disease-allele-selective
applications.requirements: Block design until exact variant, reference orientation, patient-independent research scope and sparing objective are verified. Reporter mismatch footprints are not patient alleles.

applications.name: metabolic-liver-galnac
applications.requirements: Chemistry/conjugation and liver expression are context requirements, not sequence-only delivery predictions.

applications.name: systemic-lnp
applications.requirements: Record formulation/exposure context and unmeasured delivery; unmodified cores are not clinical drugs.

applications.name: neuro-cns
applications.requirements: Require explicit isoform objective, genuine reference context and CNS expression; do not fabricate flanks or infer brain delivery.

applications.name: inflammation-immune
applications.requirements: Separate on-target biology from innate immune confounding; use frozen immune vetoes but do not claim a negative screen proves safety.

applications.name: functional-genomics
applications.requirements: Require a panel with declared seed/site diversity and controls; independent reagents are not independent benchmark cohorts.

applications.name: gene-regulation
applications.requirements: Separate direct transcript knockdown from downstream expression and phenotype.

applications.name: drug-target-validation
applications.requirements: Require orthogonal evidence and an endpoint contract; knockdown alone does not validate a drug target.
